title: Phone Numbers Operations Specialist L2
description:
Who we are
 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
 .
 Hiring and how we work
 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!
 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
 .
 See yourself at Twilio
 Join the team as Twilio’s next Phone Numbers Operations Specialist L2
 About the job
 Twilio is seeking an Operations Specialist to join the team that runs Twilio’s phone number operations globally. This role will work directly with customers to help them port their phone numbers into Twilio, ensuring a smooth and seamless process with personalized attention. The Product Operations team is a key part of Twilio’s Super Network, whose mission is to provide the infrastructure that catalogs, orchestrates, and delivers the world's connectivity.
 Responsibilities
 In this role, you’ll:
 Serve as a dedicated point of contact for ISVs as they routinely port phone numbers to Twilio and manage one-time porting projects for direct customers.
 Serve as a dedicated point of contact for Twilio’s Go To Market team in EMEA/APAC with regard to porting projects.
 Provide support for common customer inquiries received by email to ensure they have an excellent experience with Twilio.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.
 Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.
Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.
 About the role:
 We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.
 We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy.
 You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality…

title: Software Engineer Payments
description:
Lemonway is an authorised payment institution at the heart of Europe’s new digital economy.
 We secure payments for crowdfunding platforms, the collaborative economy, marketplaces, and e-commerce businesses, with a strong commitment to fraud prevention and the protection of customer funds.
 Regulated by the French Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority (ACPR) and benefiting from the European passport in 29 countries, Lemonway is based in Paris and brings together 150 multicultural and committed Lemonheroes .
 More than 400 marketplaces trust us with their payments. We manage 1.4 million user wallets and have raised €50 million from Breega, Speedinvest, and Toscafund.
 Profitable for the past four years and growing by 25% in 2025, Lemonway aims to remain one of Europe’s leading payment providers through healthy and sustainable growth.
 Industry: FinTech and online payments
 Location: Paris, France, in the Sentier district, 2nd arrondissement
 Remote work: Up to two days per week, with flexibility
 Your mission
 We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Payments Tribe, a critical part of our platform powering the payment experience across channels. You will report to the Engineering Manager of the Tribe and work closely with eight engineers across two squads: Core Banking and Payments.
 You will drive the enhancement of our platform by specifying, implementing, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting the services provided to our customers. You will work across payment APIs, payment processing, reconciliation, and core banking systems.
 This role combines technical craftsmanship, teamwork, and a product mindset within a Tribe that is central to both current and future projects for Lemonway. You will actively contribute to delivering our next-generation card payment stack for acquiring and issuing, as well as our cash management platform.

title: Kaufmännische Leitung (m/w/d) für die Simssee Klinik
description:
Dringender Verdacht auf Führungsstärke! Wir ermitteln. Sie liefern die Beweise
 als Kaufmännische Leitung (m/w/d) der Simssee Klinik in Bad Endorf
 Die Faktenlage: 426 Betten. Rund 560 Mitarbeitende. 6.000 Patientinnen und Patienten im Jahr. 50 Jahre Geschichte. Das nächste Kapitel schreiben Sie.
 Wir suchen eine Führungspersönlichkeit, die hohe Ansprüche an Ergebnisse stellt und genauso hohe an die Art, wie sie erreicht werden. Jemanden, der entscheidet, umsetzt und dabei die Menschen mitnimmt, die dieses Haus jeden Tag tragen.
 Die Rolle - Die Simssee Klinik verbindet Akutmedizin und Rehabilitation: orthopädische Akutmedizin, orthopädisch-traumatologische und geriatrische Rehabilitation sowie Psychosomatik. Hier treffen unterschiedliche Vergütungswelten, viele Berufsgruppen und anspruchsvolle Steuerungsprozesse aufeinander.
 Als kaufmännische Leitung tragen Sie die operative wirtschaftliche und organisatorische Gesamtverantwortung für die Simssee Klinik und die ambulanten Reha- und Gesundheitszentren in Bad Endorf und Rosenheim. Wir erwarten von Ihnen dieselbe unternehmerische Verantwortung wie von einer Geschäftsführung und geben Ihnen dafür eine weitreichende Handlungsvollmacht und echte Entscheidungsspielräume.
 Sie berichten direkt an den COO der Gesundheitswelt Chiemgau AG. Ziele und Finanzrahmen vereinbaren wir gemeinsam. Wie Sie daraus vor Ort Ergebnisse machen, entscheiden Sie. Controlling, Personal, IT, Einkauf und Medizincontrolling unterstützen Sie aus der Zentrale.
 Der Träger - Die Gesundheitswelt Chiemgau AG ist börsennotiert und mehrheitlich kommunal getragen. Mit rund 1.300 Mitarbeitenden in Medizin und Touristik ist sie fest in der Region verankert. Für Sie heißt das: kurze Wege, ein verlässlicher Rahmen und eine langfristige Perspektive.

 Wirtschaftsplanung, Budget, Forecast und Ergebnissteuerung

title: Tech Lead: AI & Innovation
description:
↳ Alternative locations: Barcelona, Frankfurt a.M., Leipzig, Sevilla
 Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – "Vicos". We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing.
 Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.
 Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SME. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.
 Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.
 Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy use). Developing it further takes engineers who combine technical excellence, pragmatic judgement and entrepreneurial spirit. The Tech Lead: AI & Innovation we are looking for embodies these qualities in his or her leadership. He or she is up for making a major contribution to our company and to our society.
 Tasks
 As the most senior engineer, you'll lead, grow and enable a small team of (forward deployed) engineers: hire, onboard, coach and make every engineer successful in their role.
